action_summary: Restore the best historically scored preprocessing: 512-pixel inputs with ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]. Return to batch size 64, which previously matched the score at 128 while requiring less peak memory. Preserve the checkpoint, architecture, horizontal-flip probability averaging, Kaggle paths and submission ordering. Remove the final factor of 100 to emit valid probabilities (this is not itself an expected AUC gain), trim unused imports, add unreadable-image detection and validate prediction shape, finiteness and range before saving. The credible gain is recovery toward v13/v14 performance (0.96062 versus v21 0.95243); no new leaderboard gain is claimed without data.
